Warcraft III native team textures

Extracted read-only from the installed Warcraft III 3.0.0.24268 archive.
Source paths: war3.w3mod:replaceabletextures\teamcolor\teamcolorNN.dds
              war3.w3mod:replaceabletextures\teamglow\teamglowNN.dds
These PNGs preserve the decoded RGBA pixels of the original DDS textures.
Slots 00-23 are player colours; slot 24 is Neutral Hostile.
Slot 12 is Maroon: TeamColor12 contains RGB 156, 0, 0.
Warcraft III textures are Blizzard Entertainment assets, not MIT-licensed code.
